draft.text: You came in because you felt woozy over the weekend.
You said you were not checking your blood sugar as much as you should have been.
This may be because of high blood sugar, which can make you feel lightheaded.
You will need to check your blood sugar more often and eat better to help manage your diabetes.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you felt woozy over the weekend.
We found that you were not checking your blood sugar as often as needed and ate a lot of fast food.
This may have caused your blood sugar to be high, which made you feel lightheaded.
You will check your blood sugar more often and improve your diet to better manage your diabetes.
